doc: rivet-arsenal's stations (Rivet's live motion, melee and, later, every held weapon). The claw cops are real CombatArena guards that walk at Rivet and never fire (their trigger stays on cooldown): spawns whose id starts with spar_ are sparring cops at hp 4 (the claw combo's 1 + 1 + 2 drops them on the finisher); the others carry the human hp from combat.json (one hit, owner doctrine). A dead cop stands up again at its spawn 150 ticks later. ArenaClawCops (res://features/player/arena_claw_cops.gd) runs them; --bot=rivet plays the station.
